Based on the contributor statistics for the 'a11y/context-menu-accessibility-docs' branch of the prime/design repository, I found the following top 3 contributors by number of commits:

2. Inayaili León - 77 commits
3. Aurora Pleguezuelo - 66 commits

For complete repository-wide top contributor information, you would need to view the statistics on the 'main' branch.
